control_families.note_dialog: div[tabindex=-1][role=dialog][data-test=JobApplication-Modal], no accessible name; text 'Improve your odds' / 'Indicate how you can stand out as a candidate in the note below to improve your odds.'; the questions (below); button[type=submit][data-test=JobApplicationModal--SubmitButton] 'Send application'; a 'Cancel' button; Escape closes it. control_families.choice_groups: A radio group or a checkbox group is wrapped in one <label>: the question (ending '*' when required) on its first line, then one element per option whose innerText is the option (the input's parentElement). Radio names customQuestionAnswers[<id>][jobListingQuestionOptionId]; the pronouns checkboxes have an EMPTY name (ids form-input--customQuestionSets[set<n>][question_<n>]--<option id>).
